description:
Type de projet: Site web pour une nouvelle entreprise.

Objectifs et fonctionnalités:
- Présentation des services (entretien de pelouse, déneigement, ramassage de feuilles)
- Prise de rendez-vous en ligne
- Boutique avec paiement en ligne
- Formulaire de demande de soumission gratuite

Design et marque:
- Palette de couleurs: Vert et orange.

Territoire desservi:
- Shawinigan, Grand-Mère, Trois-Rivières, Nicolet (Mauricie)

designManifest.iconDirection: A flat emblem badge: a stylized maple-leaf-meets-blade-of-grass mark split into a green half and an orange half on cream, almanac-seal feel, no text.
designManifest.signatureMove: A persistent three-segment season ribbon at the top of every page (Pelouse / Feuilles / Neige) that highlights the live season computed server-side, echoed by clipped season tabs on each service card and a 'saison en cours' caption on the framed hero plate.
designManifest.summary: The site reads like a Mauricie farmer's almanac turned into a job ledger — services and content are filed by the turning of the seasons, with a tri-season color code (grass green, harvest orange, steel-blue snow) doing the wayfinding and a slab-serif printed-ledger voice.
designManifest.typography: Zilla Slab (printed-ledger display, 500-700) paired with Work Sans (humanist body)

promptHistory.changeNotes:
Build initial complet pour Lamontagne Raymond : site d'entretien de terrain en Mauricie. Identité « L'almanach des saisons » — ruban de saisons tricolore (vert pelouse / orange feuilles / bleu acier neige) qui change selon le mois, typographie Zilla Slab + Work Sans, sur fond crème. Pages : accueil, services, boutique avec panier et caisse, prise de rendez-vous, soumission gratuite, conseils (blogue), contact, mes commandes, et confirmation. Paiement via virement Interac à la commande (instructions éditables). Back-office admin complet (CRUD pour services, produits, conseils, témoignages, soumissions, rendez-vous, commandes) avec génération d'images IA et téléversement Cloudinary.

Admin enrichment: (1) Dashboard (admin.ejs) redone with a welcome header, icon-based stat cards, an actionable 'à traiter' alert banner summarizing new quotes/bookings/orders, a Réglages shortcut card, responsive horizontal-scroll tables and proper empty states. (2) New Réglages page (views/admin-settings.ejs) + /admin/settings route lets the owner edit all functional site copy, contact info and payment/Interac instructions with per-field auto-save feedback (SETTINGS_FIELDS extracted in routes.js and reused by /api/admin/modules). (3) Module pages (admin-shell.ejs) gained a toolbar with live search, a status filter (auto-built from the status field options), a result count, and a refresh button; tables now wrap in a scroll container and show clearer empty/no-result states — full create/edit/delete CRUD preserved for every module (services with price/season/order, products with price/stock, posts, testimonials, quotes, bookings, orders). (4) Sidebar updated with a Réglages link and active-state highlighting. (5) Accessibility/contrast: visible :focus-visible outlines added to both stylesheets, richer admin button/toolbar styling, and consistent badge colors. (6) Public site: added OG/Twitter social meta to the header partial using existing settings values. All {{IMG_*}} placeholder tokens preserved byte-for-byte; routes, data flows and platform service usage unchanged; no built-in service keys added.
